reason: The bit operators are ArithmeticValues, as Java's are (RFC-257 WS-J section 6), where they were BITAND/BITOR/BITXOR scalar functions. The value's semantic hash moves with it, and in one negated TLP rendering of a three-way join that hash decides a tie between two equal-cost association orders: NLJ(FlatMap(l, m), r) becomes NLJ(l, FlatMap(m, r)). The frozen rows are unchanged.
